2010.title: Part B 图表作文：手机用户量增长情况对比
2010.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks how mobile-phone subscriptions changed from 2000 to 2008. Both rose, but those in developing countries climbed from 0.5 billion to 4 billion while those in developed countries only went from 0.7 billion to 1 billion. Both moved in the same direction, but at very different speeds. The gap between the two widened over the period.

The trend in the chart is closely tied to how people live and spend today. As household incomes have grown, mobile phone use has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. More importantly, mobile phone use now serves a practical need rather than a passing fashion. Cities have grown quickly, and demand for mobile phone use has grown with them.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Government can fund public facilities so that mobile phone use is not limited to those who can pay.
2010.apply_cn:
该柱状图记录了2000年到2008年期间手机用户数的变化。两者都在上升，但发展中国家由5亿升至40亿，而发达国家仅从7亿升到10亿。两者方向一致，但速度快慢差别很大。两者之间的差距在这一时期拉大了。

图中的变化与人们当下的生活和消费方式密切相关。随着家庭收入提高，手机的使用已从奢侈品变成日常必需品。更重要的是，手机的使用现在满足的是实际需要，而不是一时风尚。城市快速扩张，手机的使用的需求也随之增长。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。政府可以投入公共设施，让手机的使用不只属于付得起钱的人。

2011.title: Part B 图表作文：汽车品牌市场份额变化
2011.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks how the market shares of Chinese, Japanese and American car brands changed from 2008 to 2009. From 2008 to 2009, Chinese brands rose from 26% to 31%, a steady climb. Over the same period, Japanese brands fell from 35% to 26%, a clear decline. The two groups moved in opposite directions.

The trend in the chart is closely tied to how people live and spend today. As household incomes have grown, car ownership has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. More importantly, car ownership now serves a practical need rather than a passing fashion. Government support — from tax breaks to better infrastructure — has also helped.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Companies can make domestic car brands cheaper and easier to use, so that they reach more people.

该柱状图记录了2008年到2009年期间国产、日系与美系汽车品牌的市场份额的变化。自2008年至2009年，国产品牌由26%稳步升至31%。同一时期，日系品牌由35%降至26%，降幅明显。两组朝相反的方向变化。

图中的变化与人们当下的生活和消费方式密切相关。随着家庭收入提高，汽车保有量已从奢侈品变成日常必需品。更重要的是，汽车保有量现在满足的是实际需要，而不是一时风尚。政府支持——从税收优惠到基础设施改善——也起了作用。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。企业可以把国产汽车品牌做得更便宜、更好用，让它覆盖更多人。

2012.title: Part B 图表作文：某公司员工工作满意度调查
2012.apply_en:
The table shows how employee dissatisfaction is distributed among the categories. The 41-to-50 age group takes the largest share, at 64%. Those aged 40 or younger and the group over 50 come next, at 33.3% and 10%. This distribution suggests that employee dissatisfaction is still concentrated in a few categories.

The change in the chart reflects a broader shift in how people live and work. Longer working hours have made people value the time they can call their own. Young people change jobs far more often than their parents did, so loyalty works differently. What people want from a job has changed: pay alone no longer keeps them satisfied.

If nothing is done, the problem shown in the chart will only get worse. Any serious response has to come from several directions at once. Employers should find out why experienced staff are the least satisfied, not just look at the overall figure. A company that ignores this gap will lose the very people it most depends on.
2012.apply_cn:
该表格显示员工的不满意比例在各类别之间的分布情况。41~50岁组占比最高，为64%。其次是40岁及以下组和50岁以上组，分别为33.3%和10%。这种分布说明员工的不满意比例仍然集中在少数几类上。

图中的变化反映了人们生活和工作方式的更大转变。更长的工作时间让人们更看重属于自己的时间。年轻人换工作比父辈频繁得多，「忠诚」的含义已经不同。人们对工作的要求变了：只靠工资已经留不住人。

如果什么都不做，图中的问题只会更严重。任何认真的应对，都需要多个方向同时发力。雇主应弄清为什么资深员工最不满意，而不是只看总体数字。忽视这一差距的公司，会失去它最依赖的那批人。
tips: 表格、分布比高低（3 个事物 / 静态）→ 用**静态骨架**（各类别占比，没有时间变化）。
数据要点：the 41-to-50 age group 占 64%；those aged 40 or younger 占 33.3%；the group over 50 占 10%。只需要首末值 + 极值，不必逐年罗列；单位统一。
第二段套 **社会 · 职场 · 生活类第二段**：句池挑「工作 · 2012/2021」「职场 · 2012/2019」「职场 · 2012」；本段骨架 2 句 + 句池 3 句 ≈ 59 词。

2013.title: Part B 大作文：大学生兼职比例柱状图
2013.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks the proportion of college students taking part-time jobs from the first year to the final year. From the first year to the final year, the proportion of college students taking part-time jobs rose from 67.77% to 88.24%, a steady climb. Growth was slow at first and then sped up.

Behind the numbers in the chart lies a change in how students spend their time. Habits built at this stage shape how young people take responsibility later. Part-time work is one of the clearest examples. Part-time work teaches students to plan their own time rather than wait to be told. Students who take part in part-time work often work better with others.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Schools can build part-time work into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra.
2013.apply_cn:
该柱状图记录了大学生兼职比例从大一到大四的变化。自大一至大四，大学生兼职比例由67.77%稳步升至88.24%。增长起初缓慢，后来明显加快。

数字背后，是学生时间安排方式的变化。这个阶段养成的习惯，会影响他们日后承担责任的方式。兼职就是最清楚的例子之一。兼职让学生学会自己安排时间，而不是等人安排。参与兼职的学生通常更善于与人合作。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。学校可以把兼职纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。
tips: 柱状图、单值逐年上升（1 个事物 / 动态）→ 用 **① 单线上升（图里只有一个事物） 骨架**（适用 2013 · 2023）。
数据要点：the proportion of college students taking part-time jobs 67.77% → 88.24%。只需要首末值 + 极值，不必逐年罗列；单位统一。
第二段套 **校园类第二段（对应英语一品质类）**：句池挑「时间管理」「合作」；本段骨架 3 句 + 句池 2 句 ≈ 62 词。

2014.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks how the urban and rural population changed from 1990 to 2010. From 1990 to 2010, the urban population rose from 300 million to 670 million, a steady climb. The line chart tracks how the number of museums and museum visitors changed from 2013 to 2015. Both rose, but visitor numbers climbed from 640 million to 780 million while the number of museums only went from 4,200 to 4,600. The gap between the two widened over the period.

Traditional culture does not survive by being preserved in a museum. It survives when people find new ways to pass it on. The growth shown in the chart is that process at work. Museum visiting brings traditional culture closer to ordinary life instead of leaving it on the shelf. Cultural confidence grows when tradition is lived, not merely recited.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Government can fund public facilities so that museum visiting is not limited to those who can pay. Documentaries and short videos can show how museum visiting works in real life.

2021.apply_en:
The bar chart shows how the ways residents take exercise are distributed among the categories. Exercising on one's own takes the largest share, at 54.3%. Exercising with friends and exercising with family come next, at 47.7% and 23.9%. Team sports come last, at 16%. The gap between the largest and smallest categories is wide.

The figures are less about sport itself than about how people now look after themselves. Long working hours have turned health into something to plan for, and exercising is the easiest way to do that. Sitting all day has turned exercise into a practical need rather than a hobby. Fitness apps and smart watches let people track their progress and stay motivated.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Individuals should choose what fits their own situation rather than follow the crowd. Small habits matter: a little exercise every day adds up over a year.

2022.title: Part B 大作文：2018—2020年我国快递业务量变动情况
2022.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks how express delivery volume changed from 2018 to 2020. Both rose, but the rural figure climbed from 12 billion pieces to 30 billion pieces while the national total only went from 51 billion pieces to 83 billion pieces. The gap between the two widened over the period. Growth was slow at first and then sped up.

The trend in the chart is closely tied to how people live and spend today. As household incomes have grown, online shopping has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. Cities have grown quickly, and demand for online shopping has grown with them. Government support — from tax breaks to better infrastructure — has also helped.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Government can fund public facilities so that online shopping is not limited to those who can pay. Platforms should design simple, honest interfaces instead of ones that keep users hooked.

该柱状图记录了2018年到2020年期间快递业务量的变化。两者都在上升，但农村快递量由120亿件升至300亿件，而全国总量仅从510亿件升到830亿件。两者之间的差距在这一时期拉大了。增长起初缓慢，后来明显加快。

图中的变化与人们当下的生活和消费方式密切相关。随着家庭收入提高，网购已从奢侈品变成日常必需品。城市快速扩张，网购的需求也随之增长。政府支持——从税收优惠到基础设施改善——也起了作用。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。政府可以投入公共设施，让网购不只属于付得起钱的人。平台应把界面做得简单诚实，而不是想方设法让人上瘾。

2023.title: Part B 大作文：2012—2021年我国居民健康素养水平变化趋势
2023.apply_en:
The line chart tracks the health literacy rate of Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021. From 2012 to 2021, the health literacy rate of Chinese residents rose from 8.80% to 25.40%, a steady climb. Growth was slow at first and then sped up. The figure more than doubled over the period.

The figures are less about sport itself than about how people now look after themselves. Sitting all day has turned exercise into a practical need rather than a hobby. The rise is not only about money: attitudes to health have changed. Fitness apps and smart watches let people track their progress and stay motivated.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Media should report on health literacy honestly, without exaggerating its benefits or its risks. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns.

这些数字与其说关于运动本身，不如说反映了人们现在如何照顾自己。整天坐着，让运动从爱好变成了实际需要。这一增长不只因为钱：人们对健康的态度也变了。健身App和智能手表让人能记录进展、保持动力。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。媒体应如实报道健康素养，既不夸大好处，也不夸大风险。明确的规则和持续的投入，比一次性活动更重要。

2024.title: Part B 大作文：某高校劳动实践课学生主要收获调查（柱状图）
2024.apply_en:
The bar chart shows how labour practice course gains are distributed among the categories. Gaining relevant knowledge takes the largest share, at 91.3%. Improving practical ability and obtaining cheerful moods come next, at 84.8% and 54.4%. Enhancing cooperative ability comes last, at 32.6%. The gap between the largest and smallest categories is wide.

Behind the numbers in the chart lies a change in how students spend their time. Habits built at this stage shape how young people take responsibility later. Labour practice courses are one of the clearest examples. Labour practice courses teach students to plan their own time rather than wait to be told. Students who take part in labour practice courses often work better with others.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Schools can build practical training into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra.
2024.apply_cn:
该柱状图显示劳动实践课的收获在各类别之间的分布情况。获得相关知识占比最高，为91.3%。其次是提高实践能力和获得愉悦心情，分别为84.8%和54.4%。增强合作能力排在最后，占32.6%。最大类别与最小类别之间的差距很大。

数字背后，是学生时间安排方式的变化。这个阶段养成的习惯，会影响他们日后承担责任的方式。劳动实践课就是最清楚的例子之一。劳动实践课让学生学会自己安排时间，而不是等人安排。参与劳动实践课的学生通常更善于与人合作。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。学校可以把实践训练纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。

数据要点：gaining relevant knowledge 占 91.3%；improving practical ability 占 84.8%；obtaining cheerful moods 占 54.4%；enhancing cooperative ability 占 32.6%。数值与图逐个核对，别漏最大值。

2026.title: 图表作文：儿童户外活动的益处
2026.apply_en:
The bar chart shows how the perceived benefits of outdoor activities for children are distributed among the categories. Satisfying curiosity takes the largest share, at 54.6%. Improving observation skills and enhancing physical fitness come next, at 54.5% and 33.2%. Strengthening parent-child interaction comes last, at 31.2%. The gap between the largest and smallest categories is wide.

The figures are less about sport itself than about how people now look after themselves. Long working hours have turned health into something to plan for, and outdoor activity is the easiest way to do that. Sitting all day has turned exercise into a practical need rather than a hobby. Health campaigns have reminded the public that prevention is cheaper than treatment.

If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone. Families matter most: children copy what adults do far more than what they are told. Schools can build outdoor activity into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra.
2026.apply_cn:
该柱状图显示儿童户外活动的益处在各类别之间的分布情况。满足好奇心占比最高，为54.6%。其次是促进观察力和强身健体，分别为54.5%和33.2%。增强亲子互动排在最后，占31.2%。最大类别与最小类别之间的差距很大。

这些数字与其说关于运动本身，不如说反映了人们现在如何照顾自己。长时间工作让健康变成需要主动安排的事，而户外活动是最容易做到的一种方式。整天坐着，让运动从爱好变成了实际需要。健康宣传提醒公众：预防比治疗便宜。

图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。家庭最关键：孩子模仿大人怎么做，远多于听大人怎么说。学校可以把户外活动纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。
tips: 柱状图、占比分布（4 个事物 / 静态）→ 用**静态骨架**（各类别占比，没有时间变化）。注意这是**多选题**，各项占比之和 > 100%，**不能用「合计」类句子**。
数据要点：satisfying curiosity 占 54.6%；improving observation skills 占 54.5%；enhancing physical fitness 占 33.2%；strengthening parent-child interaction 占 31.2%。数值与图逐个核对，别漏最大值。
